name: Talbros Engineering Limited
about: Talbros Engineering Limited manufactures and sells rear axle shafts for automobile companies in India and internationally. The company provides spindle shafts; light, medium, and heavy-duty axle shafts; and off-highway, tandem, straight, front, and assembled axle shafts. It also provides engineering services for product development, manufacturing outsourcing, 3rd party inspection, quality certification, and drawing preparation. The company was formerly known as T. Engineering Components Limited and changed its name to Talbros Engineering Limited in November 1994. Talbros Engineering Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Faridabad, India.
